about: One image per LinkedIn post, made by the studio (tools/studio/linkedin.py) from the post's own words. The LinkedIn daily run attaches each image when it schedules the post; the posts doc names it under the post in a paragraph starting Image:.

pieces.post: Monday 23 November: Delaware franchise tax, expectation versus reality
pieces.alt: A franchise tax bill on the Authorized Shares method for 10,000,000 shares: $85,165, stamped Reality

content.title: Your first Delaware franchise tax bill

items.title: Work it out both ways
items.text: Delaware's own page says to use the method that results in the lesser tax.

items.title: Assumed Par Value Capital
items.text: A $400 minimum, at $400 for each $1 million of assumed par value capital or part of a million. It needs your issued shares and total gross assets.

items.title: Due by Monday 1 March 2027
items.text: Annual report fee $50 if not exempt. Missing 1 March brings a $200 penalty, plus interest of 1.5% a month on any unpaid tax.

pieces.post: Tuesday 24 November: who counts as an accredited investor
pieces.alt: A cheque from a friend, memo for your round, stamped Accredited? beside the SEC's three tests for an individual

content.lead: Before you take a check from a friend for your round, find out one thing:
content.title:
Are they an
accredited investor?

points.title: For an individual, the SEC's tests are:

items.title: Income over $200,000
items.text: or over $300,000 with a spouse or spousal equivalent, in each of the last two years, with a reasonable expectation of the same this year

items.title: Or a net worth over $1 million
items.text: alone or with a spouse or spousal equivalent, not counting their primary residence

pieces.post: Wednesday 25 November: research costs under the 2025 tax law
pieces.alt: A timeline: US research costs deducted in year one; research done outside the US spread over 15 years

content.lead: If your startup spends money on research and development, the 2025 tax law changed how those costs are deducted.
content.title:
Where the work is done
now matters

rows.label: Work done in the US
rows.note: deducted in the year paid or incurred

rows.label: Work done outside the US
rows.note: must still be spread over 15 years

items.title: US work: deduct in the year
items.text: For tax years beginning after 31 December 2024, under Section 174A. Spreading it over 60 months or more is optional.

items.title: A catch up for 2022 to 2024
items.text: US research costs not yet amortized can be deducted in full in the first tax year beginning after 2024, or over that year and the next.

items.title: Tag costs by where work is done
items.text: In the US or outside it, with payroll and contractor invoices tagged the same way.
